name: Discrete Ray Casting
aliases: Discrete Ray-Casting using Figueiredo-Reveillès' Naive 3D Lines
definition: Traverses a discrete representation of the ray instead of a continuous ray, using zero-order interpolation.
summary: Discrete Ray Casting is a volume rendering technique that traverses a voxelized grid using integer arithmetic via a 3D Bresenham algorithm, differing from continuous methods by treating the ray as a sequence of occupied voxels.
